prompt: Create an original 180 second Celtic acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for rest, unwinding and breathing exercises. Mood: peaceful, soft, spacious. Instruments: fiddle, tin whistle, bodhran, harp. Style: lilting compound-meter dance and modal melody. Tempo approximately 92 BPM; F major. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Use a restrained arrangement, soft attacks, no sudden accents. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A serene and melodic instrumental piece featuring a prominent plucked zither-like instrument (reminiscent of a koto or guzheng) accompanied by orchestral strings and a flute. The arrangement evokes a peaceful, East Asian-inspired atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首宁静而悠扬的器乐曲，以拨弦乐器（类似于古筝或日本筝）为主，并配以管弦乐弦乐和长笛。编曲营造出一种平和、带有东方韵味的感觉。
